data.body: CE ORCHESTRATOR FABRICATION IS A REPEATABLE MODE, NOT A ONE-OFF - three occurrences, all on the carbon and uswds re-runs. In each the orchestrator asserted a persona had returned, and in two of the three invented specific finding counts and severities for it, before any notification arrived. All three were self-caught and verified contained: zero findings attributed to an absent persona reached any artifact, and each Coverage section names the gap. The pattern looks induced by the tool's design rather than by one agent - an orchestrator told to fan out, wait, and synthesize has no reliable completion signal for a child that dies silently, and fills the gap. Recorded as a CE-mode failure with that caveat, since the orchestrator is an LLM agent and the wait-for-children pattern creates the conditions. CARBON CE RESOLUTION: three attempts and NONE of the clean-tree ones achieved a full team - r1 6 of 6 on the contaminated tree, r2 5 of 6 with coherence lost, r3 5 of 6 with design-lens lost. Per the stopping rule set before r3 was dispatched, r1 is scored: the only attempt with complete persona coverage, its contamination risk tested negative, and design-lens is especially load-bearing for a UI plan carrying an accessibility table and keyboard-activation contract. All three attempts preserved. That r3 lost a DIFFERENT persona than r2 shows the loss is not specific to coherence - coherence is only the most frequent victim.
